year_arcs.2020: Launched MVP and secured first pilot with a regional carrier, but faced a near-miss outage during peak season.
year_arcs.2021: Pivoted from manual spreadsheet integration to API-first architecture, raising a $2 M seed round.
year_arcs.2022: Experienced a hiring boom, adding 30 engineers and launching Helix Fleet, while a major customer escalated a data-privacy issue.
year_arcs.2023: Rolled out Helix Analytics, hit $1 M ARR, and endured a critical outage that led to a temporary leadership change.
year_arcs.2024: Introduced Helix API, expanded to 50 customers, and announced a Series A of $8 M.
year_arcs.2025: Launched a mobile app, cut 10% of staff in a strategic layoff, and secured a key partnership with a global logistics provider.
year_arcs.2026: Reached 200 employees, achieved $5 M monthly recurring revenue, and announced a new AI-driven routing engine.

eras.name: Bootstrap Beginnings
eras.characterisation: Documentation was ad-hoc, mostly informal notes in Google Docs and a single shared Trello board. The team relied on verbal hand-offs and quick email threads to capture requirements.

eras.name: Structured Growth
eras.characterisation: The company adopted Confluence for internal wikis and Linear for issue tracking. Process documentation grew into living SOPs, and a quarterly "Product Playbook" was created to standardise feature rollouts.

eras.name: Scale-Ready Standards
eras.characterisation: A dedicated technical writer produced API docs in Swagger, a product manager authored a comprehensive "Helix Platform Architecture" whitepaper, and all releases were accompanied by formal release notes and change-logs in GitHub.

eras.name: Agile Refinement
eras.characterisation: Documentation shifted to a living knowledge base in Notion, with a focus on user-centric guides and community forums. The team introduced a "Documentation Review" process in Jira to keep docs in sync with code.

eras.name: Enterprise-Grade Documentation
eras.characterisation: Helix Logistics now publishes a public API portal, a developer SDK, and a compliance certification guide. Documentation is versioned, searchable, and integrated with the product's data-warehouse for analytics on doc usage.

products: **Helix Fleet** - 2021 - A cloud-based freight management platform that centralises shipment tracking and carrier coordination.
**Helix Analytics** - 2023 - Real-time dashboards and predictive analytics for route optimisation and cost forecasting.
**Helix API** - 2024 - A RESTful API that exposes core logistics data for third-party integrations and custom workflows.
